summary: This project provides a Lean formal proof of the classification of finite simple groups. It is built as a Lean CLI tool that encodes the extensive mathematical argument directly in the theorem prover. Researchers and formal methods engineers seeking a verified foundation for group theory will find it useful, especially when exploring large‑scale formalizations. The standout strength is its ambitious scope, while the main caveat is its infancy—only one day old with minimal community adoption and no performance benchmarks.
